en: Color postcard showing an alpine town with high mountains and forests in the background. In the foreground is a modern light-blue building with wooden roof and green-framed windows; on its wall is the word 'laurebjorum' (uncertain reading). Behind it rises a tall stone church bell tower with a spire and cross. At the lower left corner there is an inset image of a relief or statue of a saint holding a church, with the caption 'SAN LORENZO'. Clear blue sky with a few clouds above.
